sloka: एवमुक्ता तु सा सीता तां ततो धर्मचारिणीम् ।श्रूयतामिति चोक्त्वा वै कथयामास तां कथाम् ॥ २.११८.२६॥
transliteration: evamuktā tu sā sītā tāṁ tato dharmacāriṇīm ।śrūyatāmiti coktvā vai kathayāmāsa tāṁ kathām ॥ 2.118.26॥

translations.english: 'Listen' said Sita, thus addressed, and began relating the story to Anasuya, a performer of austerities.
